__comment_TermsOptions: CurrentVersion: the Terms of Use version at /terms. Stored on the member at registration (MemberTermsAcceptedVersion).
__comment_RetentionOptions: See docs/Privacy-And-Retention.md. Retention periods (days) for the nightly retention tasks; /privacy states the same.
__comment_TagManagerConsentOptions: See docs/Privacy-And-Retention.md. No Tag Manager snippet renders until the visitor allows Analytics. AlwaysAllowedSnippetNames: snippet code names that render without it.
__comment_IndexNow: IndexNow submissions on publish. Key: 8-128 chars (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, -), served at /{Key}.txt; empty disables IndexNow. Set only in production app settings (IndexNow__Key). Endpoint defaults to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow; empty serves the key file but submits nothing.
